items.information:
# This competition has been postponed to Friday, December 30th. Please check your email for more details

This competition is on **Friday, December 30th** and will go on for the entire day. Please take a look at the schedule and plan accordingly. There is no 3x3 at this competition. 

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)

items.information: Please join us for the final Massachusetts competition of 2022! The only event at this competition will be 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.  First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition.
